name: Newcastle–Oshawa express
description: Express feeder from Newcastle and Bowmanville to Oshawa GO, complementing the slower route 90 local bus. It was replaced by route 88A in the 2020 restructuring.

timeline.event: The original timetable distinguishes Newcastle–Bowmanville–Oshawa express 91 from local route 90.
The original GTFS still contains route 91 and its Newcastle pattern.
Last day of route 91. The replacement weekday 88A began with the September schedule changes.
